steps.t: Sign in and land on My Courses
do: Open the platform and sign in as mia@school.edu.
Wait for the first screen to load.
steps.expect: You land on My Courses with “Welcome back, Mia” and three PBL programmes. The left menu shows Learn, Create and Connect groups.

steps.t: Choose a PBL programme and its STEAM activities
do: Look at the three programme cards. Sustainable Futures should show Selected.
Click Open Studio on a programme, then come back.
Scroll down to Attached STEAM Activities and read the activity cards.
steps.expect: Each programme shows its driving question and how many STEAM activities are attached. Activity cards have an Open button.

do: On My Courses, click Activity 5 · Solar Car.
In Stage 1 “Weigh It”, type a mass for one part.
Open Show the maths and check the summary numbers update.
Try one other activity from the list.
steps.expect: Six stages from Weigh It to Design Review. Totals such as Total mass and Predicted speed change as you enter values.

steps.t: Set goals with the goal wizard
do: Click Goal setting in the left menu.
Answer “What would you love to explore?” and move through the wizard.
Finish, or close it and check nothing breaks.
steps.expect: A friendly step-by-step window opens over the page and walks you from interests to goals.

do: Click Home.
Click Personalize dashboard, choose a profile picture and a banner image.
Check the preview, then try Discard dashboard preview, then do it again and Save dashboard changes.
Reload the page.
steps.expect: Your picture and banner show after saving and stay after a reload. Discard returns to the previous look.

steps.t: Studio Home: next step and asking a coach
do: Scroll to the Studio Home tab under My learning space.
Click Mark this step done on the next-step card.
Click Ask my coach, pick a reason and send a request.
steps.expect: Progress updates when a step is marked done. The coach request confirms that it was sent. (Coach testers can check it arrives.)

steps.t: Home tabs: programmes, goals and calendar
do: Open the PBL Programs tab. Read the semester cards and the class code box.
Open Learning Goals, then Academic Progress.
Open School Calendar and switch between Year, Agenda and Month views.
steps.expect: Each tab loads without an error. Empty areas say clearly that nothing is recorded yet, rather than showing a blank space or an error code.

do: Click PBL Studio in the left menu.
Click each of the seven phases from Explore to Showcase.
Tick a task, choose an interest chip such as Environment, and look at the AI co-pilot panel.
steps.expect: The phase timeline shows weeks. Task counts (for example 1/3 tasks) update as you tick.

do: In PBL Studio open Evidence portfolio. Try the Phase and Type filters.
Open Competencies and read one competency.
Open Explore: STEAM and Our approach.
steps.expect: Evidence shows the end-of-term readiness count. Competencies list how many have evidence (for example 0/14).

do: Click Portfolio maker.
In stage 1 Explore, add a photo or file as evidence.
Write a short reflection and click Save reflection.
Click Export PDF.
steps.expect: The stage counter moves from “0 of 7 stages complete”. The PDF view shows your evidence and reflection.

do: Click Showcase portfolio.
Change the heading, accent colour and layout, then Save personalization.
Click Add work to add one piece, then Preview portfolio.
Click Copy portfolio link.
steps.expect: Only the introduction, interests and chosen work appear in the preview. Personal goals stay private.

do: Open Community, write a short test post and click Post.
Open Messages. If a coach tester has messaged Mia, open it and reply.
steps.expect: Your post appears in the feed. Messages lists conversations started by a coach.

do: Open Settings from your name at the top right.
Switch Appearance to Dark, reload, then back to Light.
Switch language to ไทย or 中文 and look around, then back to English.
Do not change the password.
steps.expect: Theme and language change straight away and are still set after a reload.

steps.t: Sign in and see the activity board
do: Sign in as primary.student@school.edu.
Note what you see first. This account is marked “pending consent”.
steps.expect: A bright Junior Explorers board with eight activities, each with a “Let’s go!” button. If you see a consent or waiting screen instead, describe it.

do: Toggle Read to me and Big text on and off.
Switch between Starter (6–8) and Explorer (9–11).
steps.expect: Text size changes clearly. Activity wording changes between Starter and Explorer.

do: Click Hot Spots in Our Playground.
Press a 🔊 speaker button.
Click Start on “Get your thermometer ready”, then on Test 1.
Use All activities to go back.
steps.expect: Short steps with big buttons. The speaker reads the text aloud. Steps are simple enough for a 6–8 year old.

do: Scroll below the activities to the School Calendar.
Look for upcoming events.
steps.expect: The calendar loads without an error and is easy to read for a primary pupil.

do: Sign in as coach.rivera@school.edu.
Read the three counters: learners, PBL project records, evidence entries.
Change the Class filter to Year 9 Climate Science and back.
Click Refresh records.
steps.expect: Five learners in the class. Counters match what you see in the tabs. “Loaded” time updates on refresh.

do: Scroll to Your learners.
Search for “Mia”, then select her.
steps.expect: The learner list filters as you type and the side panel shows that learner’s work.
steps.watch: Check whether everyone in the list really belongs in Year 9 Climate Science. Note any learner who should not be there.

do: Click the PBL Studio tab.
Read the three semester programmes.
Click Open existing Sustainable Futures Studio.
steps.expect: The three programmes show. The studio opens the Sustainable Futures project view.

do: Click STEAM Activities.
Click Review on Mia Chen.
steps.expect: A table of learners with activity records and completions. Review shows Mia’s recorded activity work.

do: Click Academic Progress and choose a learner.
Use Record a dated academic observation to add a short test note.
steps.expect: The observation saves with today’s date and appears in the list. The page says provider connections are pending, which is expected for now.

do: Click Learning Goals. Choose Mia Chen, the class and a learning area.
Write a measurable goal, set a due date and click Assign goal.
steps.expect: The goal appears under the learner. Student and parent testers should then see it too.

do: Click School Calendar. Try Year, Agenda and Month.
If you can add an event, add one called “Test event” on a future date.
steps.expect: All three views load. A new event shows in the calendar for learners in your class.

do: Click Posts for students, write a short test post and click Post.
steps.expect: The post appears in the feed and in the student Community page.

do: Click Management tools at the top of the dashboard.
Look at the counters and lists, then use Back to progress overview.
steps.expect: The older management view loads and the back link returns you to the dashboard.
steps.watch: This page says its figures may be examples. Note any class names or numbers that do not match your real class.

do: Open Messages and click New.
Choose Mia Chen, type a short message and click Start.
steps.expect: The conversation opens and the message shows. It reaches Mia’s Messages page.

do: Click PBL framework in the left menu.
Open each tab: Our approach, Project phases, Explore: NGSS rubrics, Competencies.
steps.expect: Clear explanation of the programme that you could share with a new colleague.

do: Click Primary resources.
Open a Worksheet, switch Starter and Explorer.
Open the Teacher guide for the same activity and try Print.
steps.expect: Each of the eight activities has a worksheet and a teacher guide that print cleanly on A4.

do: Sign in as admin.test@school.edu.
Search for “Mia”. Filter by cohort W2E and by status.
Sort by Name and by Created. Change “Per page”.
steps.expect: Every filter and sort changes the list. The row count at the bottom matches.

do: Open Mia Chen.
Read Details, then open Account history.
Check Linked parents shows Parent Test.
Click Issue parent invite code and copy the code for the parent tester. Do not press Suspend or Unlink.
steps.expect: All fields are filled where data exists, with dashes for empty ones. An invite code is shown once.

do: Go back to Students and click Add student.
Click Create account with the form empty and read the error messages.
Fill in a made-up learner with a test email. Only press Create account if the test lead says so, otherwise click Cancel.
steps.expect: Required fields are clearly marked and errors say exactly what to fix. The page explains the learner sets their own password by email.

do: Open Staff and filter by Role.
Open Parents and check the number of children shown for Parent Test.
steps.expect: Coaches show as Course Coordinator. Parent Test shows one linked child.

do: Open School learning & calendar.
Switch School between Bangkok Campus and Online School.
Read the three semester offerings and the Create offering form.
steps.expect: Offerings load for each school and the create form is clear.

steps.t: Learning goals, calendar and learner support
do: Open the Learning Goals tab and choose a learner.
Open School Calendar and look at Review and import the school’s 2026–2027 calendar. Do not import unless asked.
Open Learner support and filter by learner.
steps.expect: Each tab loads with the learners of the chosen school. Support requests sent by student testers appear under Open requests.

do: Open Material Requests. Read the four totals at the top.
Filter by Category and Status.
Click Submit New Request and add a small test item.
Approve, reject or fulfil only your own test item.
steps.expect: Totals update when a status changes. The request shows who asked for it and why.

do: Open Financials & Billing.
Filter by Payment Status.
Click Record Payment for one test learner and enter a small amount.
steps.expect: Collected, outstanding and overdue totals update after a payment.
steps.watch: All test learners show as overdue. Tell us if the figures or wording would confuse finance staff.

do: Open Messages from the left menu.
Open a conversation between a coach and a learner, if there is one.
steps.expect: Administrators can read all conversations for safeguarding but cannot post in them.

do: Open Settings.
Read School features. Do not switch features off unless the test lead asks.
steps.expect: Each school has its own switches, with a clear note about when learners see the change.

do: In a new private window, sign in as supervisor.test@school.edu.
Open Students and a student record.
Look for any button that changes data.
steps.expect: A note says “You can view accounts. Only administrators can change them.” There is no Add, Edit or Suspend button.

name: Parent
sub: Family view of a child’s learning
who: Parent Test · parent of Mia Chen

do: Sign in as parent.test@school.edu.
Read Mia’s card: school, year level and cohort.
steps.expect: Mia Chen shows as Active at Bangkok Campus, Year 9. The page says it is a read-only view.

steps.t: Link a child with an invite code
do: Get an invite code from an admin tester (Admin step 2).
Type it into Invite code and click Link child.
Also try a made-up code such as ABCD-2345.
steps.expect: A real code links the child once. A wrong code gives a clear message about what went wrong.

do: Read the Family overview tab.
Open PBL Progress and choose Mia.
steps.expect: Plain language a parent understands. Empty areas say nothing is recorded yet.

do: Open Learning Goals and choose Mia.
Look at the badges and any goal a coach tester assigned.
steps.expect: Badges such as First Evidence and Curious Mind show. Coach-assigned goals appear here.

do: Open Academic Progress, then School Calendar.
steps.expect: Coach observations show with dates. Upcoming school events are listed.

do: Open Settings and switch language to ไทย, then back.
Go back through every tab and look for anything a parent could change by mistake.
steps.expect: Language switches cleanly. Parents cannot edit their child’s learning anywhere.
